items.title: Degree and quotient-double-coset criterion for bi-anchored thin chains in standard complex table algebras
items.author: Blau, Harvey I.
items.work: On residually thin and nilpotent table algebras, fusion rings, and association schemes
items.source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 5 (2022), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/alco.194; exact archived official publisher native/PDF
items.difficulty_reason: The target recovers every thin quotient in a nested standard-table-algebra chain from a degree formula, through a new double-coset degree-constancy criterion and recursive quotient-chain reconstruction. Even after the named quotient and homomorphism prerequisites, the bidirectional induction and exact multiplicative transfer remain substantive proof obligations beyond routine qualification-exam arguments. No later integrality or nilpotence result contributes to this rating.

items.title: Symmetric-group conjugacy classes admit cyclic descent extensions exactly outside rectangular cycle types with square-free cycle length
items.author: Adin, Ron M.; Hegedüs, Pál; Roichman, Yuval
items.work: Higher Lie characters and cyclic descent extension on conjugacy classes
items.source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 6 (2023), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/alco.323; exact archived official publisher native/PDF
items.difficulty_reason: The characterization requires constructing the nonnegative near-hook coefficient condition for higher Lie characters and proving it through divisor-sensitive estimates and a rectangular character product expansion. Classical cyclic-tableau and character-theory results alone do not give the conjugacy-class classification; the complete new hook and positivity core remains a proof obligation. Exceptional cycle parameters and the supporting hook-unimodality result are part of this one outcome.
